description: This file defines the LifecycleManager class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares the class as a plugin component that manages lifecycle events, including nested Notification class for remote connection and lifecycle state notifications. The file includes interface references, class members, and method declarations related to plugin initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval.
